description:
Play Gruul Turf.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima the Impostor, and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor token's trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
